works.title: Inworld Unreal AI Runtime
works.description: Inworld's plug-in for Unreal Engine that bundles speech-to-text, LLMs and text-to-speech behind one API key (100+ models from several providers), with a visual graph editor for building pipelines such as speech-to-speech NPC dialogue, NPC and chatbot templates, and built-in logs, traces and cost dashboards.
works.description_zh: Inworld 面向 Unreal Engine 的插件：用一个 API 密钥统一调用语音识别、大语言模型和语音合成（来自多家提供商的 100 多个模型），配有可视化节点图编辑器来搭建语音到语音的 NPC 对话等流水线，并提供 NPC 与聊天机器人模板，以及内置的日志、链路追踪和成本面板。
works.idea_en: The NPC stack becomes a configurable graph with tracing, so one character pipeline can be switched between models and every step logged, the kind of inspection a study needs.
works.idea_zh: NPC 技术栈变成一张可配置、可追踪的流程图：同一个角色流水线可以在不同模型之间切换，每一步都有记录，这正是研究所需要的可检查性。
works.method: Unreal Engine SDK exposing STT, LLM and TTS building blocks through a unified multi-provider API and a node-graph editor, with templates (including Inworld's Character Template) and observability and experimentation tools; a Unity AI Runtime SDK entered early access the same day. It follows Inworld's earlier character engine, which the launch post names as the company's starting point with game developers.
works.method_zh: Unreal Engine SDK，通过统一的多提供商 API 和节点图编辑器提供语音识别、大语言模型与语音合成模块，附带模板（包括 Inworld 的 Character Template）以及可观测性与实验工具；同日推出 Unity AI Runtime SDK 抢先体验版。它承接 Inworld 早期的角色引擎；发布文章称后者是公司服务游戏开发者的起点。
works.specs: 100+ models via one API key · Unreal Engine (Unity in early access)

works.title: DyaFDB
works.description: Instead of testing a full-duplex voice model against recordings or a scripted examiner, DyaFDB has two models talk to each other in assigned roles with shared or conflicting goals (booking a room, guarding a secret), then scores both sides offline with an external judge.
works.description_zh: DyaFDB 不再让全双工语音模型面对录音或照本宣科的考官，而是让两个模型按分配的角色直接对话，目标或一致或冲突（订会议室、守住秘密），再由外部评审在事后为双方打分。
works.idea_en: Turn-taking, overlap and interruption are joint products of two speakers, so a virtual human has to be tested against a partner that reacts; each model reshapes how the other behaves.
works.idea_zh: 轮流发言、重叠与打断是两个说话者共同造成的，所以虚拟人必须在会作出反应的对象面前测试；每个模型都会改变对方的表现。
works.method: Two full-duplex models are bridged in an 80 ms lockstep loop, each with a private role brief in a shared situation; four tasks (e.g., information pooling, attack and defence of a secret) as 140 scenarios and 7,560 recorded conversations across six self- and cross-play pairings of PersonaPlex, MiniCPM-o and Raon-SpeechChat, scored by an external judge. Scenarios, role prompts and recording protocols are announced for release.
works.method_zh: 用 80 毫秒步进同步的桥接把两个全双工模型连起来，各自拿到一份私密的角色说明，处在同一情境中；共四类任务（如信息汇集、秘密的攻防），140 个场景、7,560 段录制对话，覆盖 PersonaPlex、MiniCPM-o 与 Raon-SpeechChat 的六种自对与互对组合，由外部评审打分。场景、角色提示与录制规程已宣布将公开。
